name: International Protection (Refugee Status / Subsidiary Protection)

qualifying_event.description: A third-country national or stateless person physically present in Malta with a well-founded fear of persecution (refugee status) or facing a real risk of serious harm if returned (subsidiary protection) may lodge an application in person with the International Protection Agency (IPA) at Fafner House, Hamrun.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: A Refcom number and Asylum Seeker's Document (ASD) are issued on lodging; a personal interview follows.

requirements.blocker_text: Application is decided within 6 months of lodging, extendable to 9 months and, in complex cases, a further 3 months. A personal interview is required (legal representatives may attend only as observers and may intervene after the interview concludes). Labour-market access is only granted 9 months after lodging (JobsPlus may grant earlier access at its discretion). A negative decision may be appealed within 15 days, with free legal assistance available at the appeal stage.

outcome.duration_length: asylum-seeker phase typically 6-9+ months pending decision; recognised refugee status or subsidiary protection is indefinite

sources.title: International Protection Agency -- How To Make & Lodge an Application: procedure, 6-9+3 month timelines, interview process, 9-month work-access gate, appeal window
International Protection Agency -- What We Do: refugee status, subsidiary protection, and temporary humanitarian protection categories under the International Protection Act and CEAS

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Malta's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1. IMPORTANT DISTINCTION flagged by the source: refugee status grants family reunification rights and a path to permanent residence; subsidiary protection does NOT include family reunification entitlements. The outcome fields above are modelled on the more generous refugee-status branch (family_can_join: true) -- applicants recognised only under subsidiary protection should not assume the same family rights apply. work_rights modelled as the eventual granted-status right ('full'); during the pre-decision asylum-seeker phase, labour-market access is restricted until 9 months after lodging (JobsPlus discretion aside). citizenship_after_months left null: eventual naturalisation would run through the general mt_naturalisation track once resident, but no dedicated reduced timeline for refugees was confirmed at tier-1 in this pass. A separate 'Temporary Humanitarian Protection' national-level category exists under the International Protection Act but is not separately modelled here given limited detail available.
